question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

She knows the city most/ so I am going/ to have a look around with her.

options.text: to have a look around with her.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "She knows the city most." The word "most" is incorrectly used here. The correct word to use is "best," which is the superlative form of "well" and is used to describe someone's knowledge or skill in a particular area.
 
• The correct phrase should be "She knows the city best" to properly indicate that she has the greatest knowledge of the city.
 
• Other parts of the sentence are grammatically correct and do not need any changes.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She knows the city best, so I am going to have a look around with her."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "so I am going" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error" **– This is incorrect, as there is an error in the first part of the sentence ("She knows the city most").
 
• **Option 4: "to have a look around with her" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
